    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_JoinPreparations" name="Food, beverages, and cart are ready" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Waiter delivers the order to the guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Waiter returns to the room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AnotherOrder" name="Does the waiter have another order to prepare or deliver?" default="Flow_NoOtherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitUntilAvailableToBill" name="Wait until no other order needs preparation or delivery">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_AvailableToBill">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not anotherOrderNeedsPreparationOrDelivery</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeBillingChoice" name="Merge billing alternatives" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitGuestAccount" name="Waiter debits the guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Order" name="End"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_TakeOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeOrder_SubmitTicket" sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder" targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitTicket_StartWork" sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" targetRef="Gateway_StartKitchenAndCoordination"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartWork_PrepareFood" sourceRef="Gateway_StartKitchenAndCoordination" targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareFood_JoinPreparations" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood" targetRef="Gateway_JoinPreparations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartWork_OrderSommelier" sourceRef="Gateway_StartKitchenAndCoordination" targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderSommelier_StartParallel" sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier" targetRef="Gateway_StartSommelierAndWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartParallel_AlcoholChoice" sourceRef="Gateway_StartSommelierAndWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Task_FulfillAlcoholicBeverageOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">alcoholicBeverageIncluded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcohol" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAlcoholChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholPrepared_Merge" sourceRef="Task_FulfillAlcoholicBeverageOrder" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAlcoholChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeAlcohol_JoinPreparations" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAlcoholChoice" targetRef="Gateway_JoinPreparations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartParallel_AssignWaiter" sourceRef="Gateway_StartSommelierAndWaiter" targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignWaiter_Preparation" sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter" targetRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartWaiter_ReadyCart" sourceRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation" targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyCart_JoinWaiter" sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart" targetRef="Gateway_JoinWaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartWaiter_Nonalcoholic" sourceRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation" targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Nonalcoholic_JoinWaiter" sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" targetRef="Gateway_JoinWaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinWaiter_JoinPreparations" sourceRef="Gateway_JoinWaiterPreparation" targetRef="Gateway_JoinPreparations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinPreparations_Deliver" sourceRef="Gateway_JoinPreparations" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_Return" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_AnotherOrder" sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation" targetRef="Gateway_AnotherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherOrder_Wait" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AnotherOrder" targetRef="Event_WaitUntilAvailableToBill">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anotherOrderNeedsPreparationOrDelivery</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOtherOrder" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AnotherOrder" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBillingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_MergeBilling" sourceRef="Event_WaitUntilAvailableToBill" targetRef="Gateway_MergeBillingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeBilling_Debit" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeBillingChoice" targetRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Debit_End" sourceRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount" targetRef="EndEvent_Order"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/evanstonian/room-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_RoomServiceCall" name="Room-service call"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_RoomService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Hotel" name="The Evanstonian" processRef="Process_RoomService"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RoomServiceCall"
                      name="Guest calls room service"
                      sourceRef="Task_GuestCallsRoomService"
                      targetRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall"
                      messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Call room service" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Guest" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GuestCallsRoomService"
                   name="Call room service"
                   messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Guest" name="End"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GuestStart_Call"
                       sourceRef="StartEvent_Guest"
                       targetRef="Task_GuestCallsRoomService"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GuestCall_End"
                       sourceRef="Task_GuestCallsRoomService"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Guest"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_RoomService" name="Room-service order" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_RoomService">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Manager" name="Room-service manager">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_RoomServiceCall</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TakeOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SubmitKitchenTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StartKitchenAndCoordination</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderSommelier</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StartSommelierAndWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AlcoholIncluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeAlcoholChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignWaiter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Kitchen" name="Kitchen">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareFood</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Sommelier" name="Sommelier">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FulfillAlcoholicBeverageOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Waiter" name="Waiter">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReadyCart</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_JoinWaiterPreparation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_JoinPreparations</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReturnToStation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AnotherOrder</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_WaitUntilAvailableToBill</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeBillingChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DebitGuestAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall" name="Guest calls room service">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RoomServiceCall"
                                  messageRef="Message_RoomServiceCall"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TakeOrder" name="Take down the order"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket" name="Submit the order ticket to the kitchen"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartKitchenAndCoordination"
                          name="Begin food preparation and order coordination"
                          gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFood" name="Prepare the food"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrderSommelier" name="Give the order to the sommelier"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartSommelierAndWaiter"
                          name="Begin beverage work and waiter assignment"
                          gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"
                           name="Does the order include wine or another alcoholic beverage?"
                           default="Flow_NoAlcohol">
      <bpmn:documentation>Eighty percent of room-service orders include wine or another alcoholic beverage.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FulfillAlcoholicBeverageOrder"
               name="Fetch wine and prepare other alcoholic beverages"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAlcoholChoice"
                           name="Merge alcoholic-beverage alternatives"
                           gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignWaiter" name="Assign the order to the waiter"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation"
                          name="Prepare the cart and nonalcoholic drinks"
                          gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadyCart" name="Ready the cart">
      <bpmn:documentation>Put a tablecloth on the cart and gather silverware.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks" name="Prepare nonalcoholic drinks"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_JoinWaiterPreparation"
                          name="Cart and nonalcoholic drinks are ready"
                          gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_JoinPreparations"
                          name="Food, beverages, and cart are ready"
                          gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver the order to the guest's room"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReturnToStation" name="Return to the room-service station"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AnotherOrder"
                           name="Does the waiter have another order to prepare or deliver?"
                           default="Flow_NoOtherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WaitUntilAvailableToBill"
                                 name="Wait until no other order needs preparation or delivery">
      <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_AvailableToBill">
        <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not anotherOrderNeedsPreparationOrDelivery</bpmn:condition>
      </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeBillingChoice"
                           name="Merge billing alternatives"
                           gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DebitGuestAccount" name="Debit the guest's account"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Order" name="End"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_TakeOrder"
                       sourceRef="StartEvent_RoomServiceCall"
                       targetRef="Task_TakeOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TakeOrder_SubmitTicket"
                       sourceRef="Task_TakeOrder"
                       targetRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SubmitTicket_StartWork"
                       sourceRef="Task_SubmitKitchenTicket"
                       targetRef="Gateway_StartKitchenAndCoordination"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartWork_PrepareFood"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_StartKitchenAndCoordination"
                       targetRef="Task_PrepareFood"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrepareFood_JoinPreparations"
                       sourceRef="Task_PrepareFood"
                       targetRef="Gateway_JoinPreparations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartWork_OrderSommelier"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_StartKitchenAndCoordination"
                       targetRef="Task_OrderSommelier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderSommelier_StartParallel"
                       sourceRef="Task_OrderSommelier"
                       targetRef="Gateway_StartSommelierAndWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartParallel_AlcoholChoice"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_StartSommelierAndWaiter"
                       targetRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholYes"
                       name="Yes"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"
                       targetRef="Task_FulfillAlcoholicBeverageOrder">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">alcoholicBeverageIncluded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAlcohol"
                       name="No"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_AlcoholIncluded"
                       targetRef="Gateway_MergeAlcoholChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AlcoholPrepared_Merge"
                       sourceRef="Task_FulfillAlcoholicBeverageOrder"
                       targetRef="Gateway_MergeAlcoholChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeAlcohol_JoinPreparations"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAlcoholChoice"
                       targetRef="Gateway_JoinPreparations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartParallel_AssignWaiter"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_StartSommelierAndWaiter"
                       targetRef="Task_AssignWaiter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AssignWaiter_Preparation"
                       sourceRef="Task_AssignWaiter"
                       targetRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartWaiter_ReadyCart"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation"
                       targetRef="Task_ReadyCart"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadyCart_JoinWaiter"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReadyCart"
                       targetRef="Gateway_JoinWaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartWaiter_Nonalcoholic"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_StartWaiterPreparation"
                       targetRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Nonalcoholic_JoinWaiter"
                       sourceRef="Task_PrepareNonalcoholicDrinks"
                       targetRef="Gateway_JoinWaiterPreparation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinWaiter_JoinPreparations"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_JoinWaiterPreparation"
                       targetRef="Gateway_JoinPreparations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinPreparations_Deliver"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_JoinPreparations"
                       targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deliver_Return"
                       sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder"
                       targetRef="Task_ReturnToStation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Return_AnotherOrder"
                       sourceRef="Task_ReturnToStation"
                       targetRef="Gateway_AnotherOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OtherOrder_Wait"
                       name="Yes"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_AnotherOrder"
                       targetRef="Event_WaitUntilAvailableToBill">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">anotherOrderNeedsPreparationOrDelivery</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoOtherOrder"
                       name="No"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_AnotherOrder"
                       targetRef="Gateway_MergeBillingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_MergeBilling"
                       sourceRef="Event_WaitUntilAvailableToBill"
                       targetRef="Gateway_MergeBillingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeBilling_Debit"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_MergeBillingChoice"
                       targetRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Debit_End"
                       sourceRef="Task_DebitGuestAccount"
                       targetRef="EndEvent_Order"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
